scope: Focused N512 native448 retained small plain37 memory/cache replay; deterministic degree12 periodic curve, distinct from the saved sigmoid curve

sanitizer_replay.instrumentation: ASan/UBSan focused translation unit and instantiated headers; prebuilt libraries and FFT assembly uninstrumented; leaks disabled; no race detection

checks: all 256 complex slots finite and below 2^-23 error against independently evaluated real/imaginary periodic curve
tile12 and tile1 output ciphertext coefficients identical
staged public-key relin, factor/output-conjugation and tail-rotation FFT pointers remain empty
retained fixture file hashes unchanged after evaluation

static_lifetime_review.staged_factor: Per-tile unique_ptr owns factor cache across synchronous evaluate_group calls; reset before construction of staged_relin
static_lifetime_review.loaded_selectors: Group-local selector/cache vectors survive synchronous packedFactorsBatch calls
static_lifetime_review.staged_relin: Per-tile unique_ptr spans both product trees and completion of that tile
static_lifetime_review.series_inputs: Requests point into the fixed input span; results are separately initialized with transparent zero
static_lifetime_review.fft_processors: Generic FFT processors in mulfft.hpp are thread_local

limitations: Static review found no concrete lifetime defect; it does not prove absence of races
Small-ring replay does not qualify full-ring correctness or explain historical unsaved sigmoid failures
A running process with empty stderr is not a completed sanitizer pass
